session: Hybrid Life → Adventure exploratory playtest; Agent/Chromium, not a human play session
seedMethod: Native createGame(2026) state from seed-2026.json. Immediately before first navigation in the accepted fresh Chromium profile, wrapper replaced lastSavedAt with Date.now() (approximately 2026-10-05T00:00:48Z; exact milliseconds were not logged and later autosave overwrote it) and added playJournal {version:1, worldId:'hybrid-life-adventure-2026', pending:[]}. This wrapper was my initialization choice, not required by the app; the app accepts a raw save and creates an empty journal. It added route-specific journal provenance; worldSeed=2026, rngState=924864733, worldTime=480 and character/NPC/resources/gameplay fields were otherwise unchanged. Readback verified seed/RNG/time before UI 起身. All subsequent mutations were through normal UI.
preflight: A first attempted profile was overwritten by old pagehide autosave after localStorage initialization. That run was stopped before exploration and excluded from the 60-minute clock. The successful profile used a fresh userdata directory and verified seed 2026 before opening.

checkpoints.place: Northern forest; heading back to Oakvale
checkpoints.shortReward: Two planted plots; two logs of wood plus 4 gold per chop; first gray wolf victory paid 12 gold/25 XP and level-up.
checkpoints.midGoal: Earn 80 gold and buy a home. Initial 45 gold → 61 after wolf → 65 after one more harvest; gathered materials can cover the remaining gap.
checkpoints.longGoal: Earn enough reputation and settlement growth to qualify for farm land/business; unclear at this point how those unlocks will be reached.
checkpoints.unexpectedEvent: A 'seek monster' UI choice triggered a level-2 gray wolf while the opening goal was farming and home ownership.
checkpoints.meaningfulChoice: Fight rather than flee; accepted an 8-stamina cost and took damage for 12 gold, 25 XP, a monster material, and a level-up.
checkpoints.newInformation: Home costs 80 gold; farmland requires 140 gold + 10 reputation + a village. Property panel states farm business is manually worked, not automatic income.
checkpoints.progress: Life actions farming=2; two live crop growth timers, 4 wood, combat level 2, home still a tangible near-term goal.

signals.rewardDrought: No new event or harvest reward in the first plot growth interval; rewards were small action feedback and the combat spike.
signals.repetitionWall: Not yet, although repeated harvesting/collecting is the visible way to close the home price gap.
signals.meaninglessReward: No evidence yet: wood can be sold for 4 each; combat drops directly improved gold/XP.

checkpoints.retentionHole: Identity stayed only 'resident' after farming and combat, and reputation remained 0 before ownership. Whether daily activity becomes a memorable role needs later observation.

checkpoints.place: At own home in Oakvale, reading identity and local news
checkpoints.shortReward: First crop harvested for 5 food and farming XP. Home storage can hold food separately; deposited 5 while keeping 3 carried.
checkpoints.midGoal: Build toward farmland/business ownership. The property screen shows this blocked by three distinct conditions: village stage, 10 reputation, and 140 gold.
checkpoints.longGoal: Become recognized as a farmer/owner and establish a farm business; UI does not explain an actionable path to village/10 reputation yet.
checkpoints.unexpectedEvent: After one gray wolf fight, Hugo 16 knew 'I heard you once protected Oakvale'; speaking to him gave a village thank-you response. Seed baseline life record for Hugo 16 had no memories. This ties the adventure action into NPC memory/identity continuity.
checkpoints.meaningfulChoice: Fight Wolf rather than flee; later sold all four wood (16 gold) to reach 81, bought home for 80, then stored five crop foods in it. Home creates actual rest/storage utility but no income.
checkpoints.newInformation: The home is recorded in the Life ledger and reputation went 1→2; however visible player identity remained only 'resident'. No pending request, news, or living-event arc appeared by day four; World History remained at one foundation entry.
checkpoints.progress: Home acquired; 5 foods safely stored, 3 retained; reputation 2; first life harvest, a battle-driven NPC memory, and combat level 2. Second plot has 17h left at in-game day3 20:20, then about 16h by day3 20:56.

signals.rewardDrought: Between early crop planting and maturity, little new life feedback; combat supplied the largest surprise/reward. After home buy, first harvest and NPC thank-you arrived within the next few minutes.
signals.goalDrought: No immediate goal drought. Next threshold is visible but appears far: 140g/10 reputation/village.
signals.repetitionWall: Repeated two-click preparation/planting and four identical sales enabled home; the loop took several routine interactions.
signals.meaninglessReward: Wood and food had explicit sale value; stored food has visible capacity/ownership utility. Home currently yields no income or new identity label.
signals.eventConsequence: Combat victory created/triggered a durable Hugo memory and gratitude line; local-news page itself remained empty.

checkpoints.retentionHole: Life/adventure state crosses via history, property, reputation and Hugo's memory, but the player stays 'resident' after 5 farming actions, home ownership, trade and combat; reaching land/business looks gated behind slow settlement/reputation progression. Mira 1, an 18-year-old farmer, had worker career and focus on farming but no shared memory with the player; dialogue was generic and did not change her familiarity or memory visibly.
